resources.string: Nothing could be measured, so this test proves nothing either way.
Deep mode is off. The in-app browser lane is exactly what Deep mode exists to cover — that is the switch to try if it leaked.
Deep mode is on, so the browser lanes were going through Nullroute\'s tunnel when this ran.
Filtering is paused or off, so a leak below is the expected result and proves nothing about your blocklist.
What this test cannot see

A blocked result in every lane does not mean everything is blocked. Deep mode cannot touch an app that speaks encrypted DNS to an address built into the app, because there is no name for Nullroute to read and no lookup to answer. It cannot block ads served from the same domain as the content, and it filters nothing while another VPN holds the slot. This test measures three lanes on one domain; it is evidence, not a guarantee.
The system resolver refused the name outright, which is what a blocked domain looks like from an app.
